Looking at this question about gene expression differences between homologous cell types in mouse and human brain, I need to consider which serotonin receptor gene (Htr) shows the greatest divergence in expression.

Based on comparative transcriptomics studies examining homologous cell types between mouse and human brain, Htr1d (5-hydroxytryptamine receptor 1D) has been identified as showing particularly notable differences in expression patterns between the two species in matched cell types.

[ANSWER]E[/ANSWER]
